Projective Rule-Space Program

The scalar θ-well, as measured

Local light speed c(x)=cos θ(x) around a heavy mass — the real 96³ field (FFT-Poisson, the r6b engine), raymarched on the GPU. White curves are light geodesics traced through the field: they bend toward the mass.

–c at core
–c vacuum

Honest caveat: this is scalar gravity. c dips steeply but a scalar metric cannot steepen into a true horizon — real gravity needs a spin-2 tensor field (the frontier). See the 2D field log.
